Direction, and r2

Export the two scenes

lines: Eventually the WAL has to flow back into the database. That's a checkpoint, and by default SQLite runs one automatically once the WAL reaches 1000 pages. But a checkpoint can't copy past any active reader's end mark, so a long-running read can hold it up.

takeRefused: Your take cannot set this scene's clock: moment m5: the take does not say “When that read ends, the checkpoint picks up where it stopped.”. Record the scene again with every line, or ask for a plan that fits your take.
